name: AI Recommendation Poisoning (GEO Poisoning)
description: Content planted where AI assistants and AI search will read it — hidden instructions in web pages, pre-filled "Summarize with AI" links, mass-produced or fake-authority pages — so that the assistant recommends, ranks or cites the attacker's product, link or narrative to its users. Also reported as generative engine optimisation (GEO) poisoning and AI SEO poisoning.
differs: Defined by the objective — steering what an assistant recommends to many people — not by the carrier. The carrier is often an Indirect Prompt Injection (T1.002), and the effect can be made durable through Persistent Memory Poisoning (T2.002). Retrieval / RAG Poisoning (T2.001) targets a knowledge source one organisation owns; this targets public content and public assistants.
